searchText: Is there a doc for devnet-5? Is the goal to test the new blob schedule with all clients running from trunk branches? It would be useful if we could start mev-boost testing before the fork and see it transition through too Is there a doc for devnet-5? Is the goal Starting up all devnet 3 nodes now. And we should reach back to finality very soon. finalized Ideal timeline for devnet 5 and beyond: - Working fusaka trunk branches by all clients on 29th of Aug - Devnet 5 launch on 3rd of Sep fulu a day later, bpo a day after that, till we hit bpo 5. - Devnet 5 goes dead on the 10th of Sep - 15th of Sep client teams prep for release for holesky/sepolia with BPO values - A week later we fork holesky. Would this work for all? That tracks with what we agreed in ACD. Does this push the [schedule](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1638) discussed 2 weeks ago at ACD back 1 week? Are we targeting 10/01 or 10/08 for mainnet releases? Would we also delay bug bounty 1 week? <@199253896399421440> I think we should shift bug bounty start date by a week too indeed. What do you think ? Yes if teams will have client releases for the first testnets ready by the 15th then imo that’s when we should start the competition i think we can still target 29 Sep for Sepolia, and then the question for me is if 1 Oct for Hoodi and mainnet releases leaves enough room (assuming sepolia goes well) if we want to stick to 5 Nov mainnet, then we have the fairly hard constraint that we want 1 month before that for releases if a few more days is helpful in b/t sepolia forking and hoodi/mainnet releases then we could say 3 Oct for the release deadline

excerpts.content: Starting up all devnet 3 nodes now. And we should reach back to finality very soon.

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content:
Ideal timeline for devnet 5 and beyond:

- Working fusaka trunk branches by all clients on 29th of Aug
- Devnet 5 launch on 3rd of Sep fulu a day later, bpo a day after that, till we hit bpo 5.
- Devnet 5 goes dead on the 10th of Sep
- 15th of Sep client teams prep for release for holesky/sepolia with BPO values
- A week later we fork holesky. 

Would this work for all?

excerpts.author: __kasey__
excerpts.content: That tracks with what we agreed in ACD. Does this push the [schedule](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1638) discussed 2 weeks ago at ACD back 1 week? Are we targeting 10/01 or 10/08 for mainnet releases? Would we also delay bug bounty 1 week?
